name: Wet Season Peak
description: High-flow wet season pulse — December through February. Creates spawning habitat and flushes fine sediments from gravel beds.

name: Wet Season Base
description: Sustained wet-season baseflow — March through April. Maintains inundated floodplain habitat following peak flows.

name: Spring Recession
description: Gradual snowmelt-driven recession — May through June. Supports juvenile salmon and steelhead outmigration.

name: Dry Season
description: Summer and early-fall low flows — July through October. Critical thermal stress period for cold-water fish species.

name: Fall Pulse
description: First-flush storm event — November. Triggers adult salmon migration and opens sand bars at river mouths.
